<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">

<title>Black Dodo 44</title>
<style>
/* From Uiverse.io by gharsh11032000 - https://uiverse.io/gharsh11032000/black-dodo-44 */
/* From Uiverse.io by gharsh11032000 - Tags: button, border, hover effect */
.button {
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  padding: 0.6em 1.2em;
  font-size: 1em;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-family: inherit;
  background-color: #1a1a1a;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: white;
  transition: border-color 0.25s;
}

.button:hover {
  border-color: #646cff;
}

.button:focus,
.button:focus-visible {
  outline: 4px auto -webkit-focus-ring-color;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Vite Button
</button>
</body>
